authorization: User authorized deleting useless checkpoints and trying genuine 10M replay in system RAM, then a full run if the JAX implementation passes validation.
learner: Native CHORD FlashSAC with CPU-backed committed replay storage; fresh initialization
backend: NumPy arrays in CPU RAM, ordered JAX io_callback for append/gather; not a disk map and not duplicated experiences
comparison_guard: Typed learner config equality except replay.capacity plus identical input motion SHA

validation.replay: GPU parity against native storage, one/seven-step returns and float16/float32 storage, terminal/truncated transitions, non-divisible ring rollover, pending flush and clear, fixed-key samples, reward relabeling
validation.learner: Full native learner parity through 38 collections and 124 updates, float32 and mixed precision; parameters, Adam state, target network, counters, RNG keys, losses and actions
validation.resume: Native compact checkpoint round trip; native reset of per-environment discounted return and empty replay is expected
validation.capacity_profile: 10500096 real transitions with 2048 worlds and batch 2048, filling and wrapping all 10M entries
validation.launch_gate: Current host source hash must match successful GPU parity and capacity reports; last 20 profile throughput samples median >=21000 transitions/s, no skipped updates, no guard stop. This projects to <=4.63h, allowing setup within the 5h wall cap.
validation.storage_choice: Original separate-array backend passed strict learner parity. Packed variants did not satisfy the unchanged 2e-6 learner tolerance and were rejected. The first profile was intentionally stopped at 5.32M to test these optimizations; final fill/rollover validation uses the original verified backend. Throughput gate revised from a 4h preference to the explicit 5h wall cap before final profile completion; this is not a learning-parameter change.

checkpoint_retention: Keep every small policy and timing sidecar; keep optimizer states at the six evaluation milestones and the latest two; record intermediate-state deletion. Replay contents remain volatile, matching native save_replay=false.
evaluation: After training frees GPU memory, evaluate policies near 60/100/150/200/250/300/350M over 16 worlds, frame-zero starts, zero assistance, full sequence, raw poses and mesh plus independently verified AUC/SP-SR/MP-SR/MPPE.

memory_guards.host_preflight: cgroup usage plus 1.25x replay payload below 90% of cgroup limit

reporting: Local tier-input-reference one-episode/one-seed metrics, not official leaderboard scores. Report terminal separately from earlier best checkpoint. Scheduled summaries 00/06/12/18 America/New_York only. Keep prepaid instance on.

cleanup.preserved: Every policy, raw evaluation, log and source; final optimizer state of each native full run; 300M optimizer state of 5M run; paused custom run untouched
